content.text: Night waking at 8 does happen, often around a stretch of stress, a growth spurt, or just a habit that crept back. Tonight, keep the 2am visit boring: walk her back to bed, keep the lights off, say a short line like "it's the middle of the night, time to sleep," and skip the long chats or snacks. Keeping the response the same every night is what usually helps it fade.
